_comment: OBS Browser Source page /rewind/ (URL https://nathanpburson.github.io/novena/rewind/ must never change; not in nav, noindex). PLAYLIST: node build_pages.js copies /workspace/ops/rewind/playlist.json (override with $REWIND_MANIFEST) to data/rewind_playlist.json; format {"apiKey":"optional Google API key (needed for Drive)","blocks":["DRIVE_ID" | {"driveId":"..."} | {"url":"direct .mp4"} | {"youtubeId":"..."}, optional durationSec/title]}. Empty/missing playlist -> plays videoId below. Browser test: python3 tools/rewind_browser_test.py ROTATE: rotateSec = max seconds a block plays before moving on (or it ends, whichever first). Blocks may set start/end (seconds) to bound where they play; each pass resumes at a new spot, wrapping to start before end. Position (block, time, offsets) is saved in localStorage every 5s and resumed on reload/OBS refresh. Test overrides: ?rotate=20 ?reset=1.
banner: Audio is LIVE · Gameplay is a REWIND
